digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center backend adapter / TicketTransport protocol
propositions: JiraDataCenterTransport lacks twelve methods the reconciler core requires, causing crashes in writing paths or silent degradation when exceptions are swallowed at call sites.
The TicketTransport Protocol declares only six members but the core calls for twenty-one distinct transport methods, leaving eleven unguarded absences that fail as AttributeError or silently degrade.

Seven of the twelve missing methods have call sites that catch Exception at every invocation, so absence produces silent operational failure (no synced comments, links, parents, properties) rather than visible crashes.

Reporter sync will churn infinitely on DC without fixing inbound_fields._identity_of to read DC's 'name' into the account_id key, since currently accountId is None and _diff_reporter re-emits the mutation every pass.

Cloud's get_parent_map implementation uses /rest/api/3/search/jql with cursor pagination and rejects startAt with HTTP 400; DC requires /rest/api/2/search with offset pagination, so copying the Cloud path breaks on DC.
TicketTransport lacks @runtime_checkable decorator, so isinstance checks raise TypeError instead of detecting missing members at construction time where the backend is built.
